key.name: panel-label-mode
key.summary: Which metric to show in the panel
key.description: Options: min, claude-session, claude-weekly, codex-session, codex-weekly

key.name: keepalive-enabled
key.summary: Keep the Claude session window open
key.description: When enabled, sends one tiny message to Claude whenever no 5-hour session window is currently active, so the window opens now instead of at your next real message. Off by default.

key.name: keepalive-command
key.default: 'claude -p ok --model haiku --strict-mcp-config --setting-sources "" --no-session-persistence --tools "" --system-prompt "Reply with the single word: ok"'
key.summary: Command used to ping Claude and open the 5-hour session window
key.description: GNOME Shell does not see the user's login shell PATH, so buildShellCommand() already prepends $HOME/.local/bin and $HOME/.claude/local to PATH before running this command. An absolute path to the claude binary may be needed for unusual installs.
